name: EssilorLuxottica S.A. Actions P
summary: EssilorLuxottica is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. The company's portfolio includes well-known brands such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, and Essilor lenses. The company is headquartered in Charenton-le-Pont, France.
